name: comfortable-video
description: Comfortable Video - 快適な動画視聴環境を提供するChrome拡張機能

scripts.build:ts: bun build src/content.ts --outfile=dist/content.js --target=browser && bun build src/background.ts --outfile=dist/background.js --target=browser && bun build src/options.ts --outfile=dist/options.js --target=browser
scripts.build:copy: rsync -a public/ dist/ || cp -r public/. dist/ || true
scripts.build: bun run build:scss && bun run build:ts && bun run build:copy
scripts.rebuild: bun run clean && bun run build
